description: This file defines an interface 'MappingResultHandler' for handling different outcomes of message mappings within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically in the connectivity messaging service. It includes methods for handling successful mappings, drops, exceptions, result combination, and topic path resolution.

classes.name: MappingResultHandler
classes.description: Interface providing methods for handling outcomes of message mapping operations, supporting multiple results per message and topic path resolution.

methods.name: onMessageMapped
methods.description: Called when a message has been successfully mapped.

methods.name: onMessageDropped
methods.description: Called when a message mapping results in no output, indicating the message should be dropped.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Called when an exception occurs during message mapping.

methods.name: combineResults
methods.description: Combines two results into one, supporting multiple mapping results from a single message.

methods.name: emptyResult
methods.description: Creates an empty or neutral result, serving as the identity for combination.

methods.name: onTopicPathResolved
methods.description: Stores the resolved TopicPath for logging or error response purposes.
